steps.description: This is the project `opencode.json` permission block that turns the gates off. The page says this is the route the desktop application needs, since it has no flag to pass, and it is only defensible inside the container from the previous section.
`"*": "allow"` approves everything, which is the same as running the container with `opencode --auto`.

title: Turning the Gates Off
